tooltip.mythblades.rainbow.1: Hits leave a random color effect (fire, weakness, glow, poison, slowness, blindness, levitation)
tooltip.mythblades.rainbow.2: Right-click: throw a rainbow crescent · In mid-air: cloud step
tooltip.mythblades.crimson.1: Every hit fills the veins with essence and steals life
tooltip.mythblades.crimson.2: Right-click: Crimson Lunge — dash into the targeted enemy, stronger with essence
tooltip.mythblades.mossroot.1: Hold and release: slam the ground, the shockwave launches enemies
tooltip.mythblades.mossroot.2: Right-click stone/dirt: grow moss · Chops trees fast
tooltip.mythblades.mossroot.3: Repairs itself in rain or on grass
tooltip.mythblades.ember.1: Hits set enemies on fire · While held you resist fire and lava
tooltip.mythblades.ember.2: Right click: Flame Slash — burns enemies in an arc in front of you
tooltip.mythblades.ember.3: Sneak + right click: Ember Plunge — stab the ground for a burst of embers
tooltip.mythblades.seal.1: Hold it to pull the sword out of an Ember Altar
tooltip.mythblades.seal.2: Right click: shows the direction of the nearest Ember Altar
msg.mythblades.seal_dir: The seal grows warm... an Ember Altar lies %s blocks away, %s
msg.mythblades.seal_none: The seal is cold. There is no Ember Altar nearby.
msg.mythblades.altar_locked: The sword won't budge and its hilt burns like an ember... You need an Ember Seal.
msg.mythblades.altar_pull: The seal melts... the stone cracks and the sword rises!
msg.mythblades.altar_pull_free: The sword knows you and rises...
msg.mythblades.altar_empty: The altar is empty. You can plunge Emberbrand back in.
msg.mythblades.altar_return: The sword settles into the stone. Only you can pull it without a seal.
